added_failure_derivation: The reviewed run's manifest has empty baseline_suite and after_suite fields, and no completed paired gate logs; the failure-id set difference is unmeasured, so count is null rather than zero.

findings.text: blocking: writer_for chooses attachment_audit.py whenever that operation appears, but vertical_coordinate_of_active_limiter_point has both detach_inconsistent_attachment and detach_stale_source_binding, and the changes query omits timestamps; the selected responsible writer is not established by the recorded evidence.

follow-on: an exhausted derived name without children and with a source-holding successor is classified as an orphan although the plan restricts that population to non-derived names, so a future rerun can count a name the retirement selector excludes.

follow-on: population_counts is constructed from rows immediately above, making its summed count equal len(rows) for every classification or omission; this assertion cannot detect a missing sourceless name and should not count as independent completeness coverage.

item_verdicts.diff: the single commit 04585599c776eeb46389a9e89e175bccbe37ce66 adds a 623-line read-only census script, 264-name results JSON and 362-line HTML report; its classification, writer attribution, controls and aggregate assertions were read against base 993ddf413d290b09d1c8ea7518e2fdc4a0209b2f.
item_verdicts.done_when: docs/evidence/fragments/sn-integrity-backlog/sib-source-loss-census-run.py:34-48 and :470-488 assert four planted controls, four live witnesses, a 264-name cohort and a 222-name exhausted dropped-edge count; census-uniqueness.log records these checks and EXIT=0.
item_verdicts.goal: docs/evidence/fragments/sn-integrity-backlog/sib-source-loss-census.html:5-23 reports all 264 sourceless live names in four populations and the results JSON lists every name, but one named writer attribution is unsupported.
item_verdicts.manifest: the source run manifest.md:11-25 names its commit, three changed paths and census-uniqueness.log, whose 5137-node control, 264-name result and EXIT=0 agree; baseline_suite and after_suite are empty, so added failures are unmeasured.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the source brief grants three census artifacts and an unused figure directory; git diff 993ddf413d290b09d1c8ea7518e2fdc4a0209b2f..04585599c776eeb46389a9e89e175bccbe37ce66 adds exactly the three granted artifacts.

justifications.durability: sib-source-loss-census-run.py:47 would fail if classify mislabels a planted population and :487 would fail if a named live witness moves class, but :471 compares a Counter made from rows with the same rows and cannot detect an omitted row.
justifications.evidence: census-uniqueness.log records the property-positive control, four fixture outcomes, four live witnesses and EXIT=0, while the source manifest.md:21-22 supplies no completed baseline or after suite arm.
justifications.fit: sib-source-loss-census-run.py:51 uses the repository GraphClient, read-only bounded Cypher and escaped HTML output, but :27 omits the non-derived condition from the orphan population rule.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/evidence/fragments/sn-integrity-backlog/sib-source-loss-census-results.json:1 carries all 264 names and 62 comparison cases, but sib-source-loss-census-run.py:242 assigns one of two recorded detachment writers without evidence of which caused the final absence.
justifications.reuse: imas_codex/standard_names/ledger.py:96 owns a narrower active-orphan query and provenance_rebuild.py:294 owns repair-time predecessor recovery; the standalone four-population census in sib-source-loss-census-run.py:24 extends neither runtime capability and duplicates neither owner.
justifications.scope_discipline: the sole commit adds only docs/evidence/fragments/sn-integrity-backlog/sib-source-loss-census-run.py, sib-source-loss-census-results.json and sib-source-loss-census.html, all declared in the source brief.
